title: A high-throughput SARS-CoV-2 pseudovirus multiplex neutralization assay
protocol: Seed a 96-well half area plate with Vero E6 hACE2 T2A TMPRSS2 cells as described in steps 16–20 of the before you begin section.
Incubate 96-well plates overnight and at least for 16 hours at 37°C, 5% CO2 prior to use.
Add 33.6 μL of infection media to row A (columns 1–10) and row E (columns 1–10).
Add 28 μL of infection media to the remaining wells.
Add 1.4 μL of plasma sample to row A (columns 1–10) and row E (columns 1–10).
Perform a 5-fold serial dilution by transferring 7 μL of the plasma/infection media from row A down to row D.
Perform the same serial dilution for the duplicate from row E down to row H.
Discard the last 7 μL so that all wells have a total volume of 28 μL.
Make a master mix of the two SARS-CoV-2 pseudoviruses, each containing a unique fluorophore (eGFP and mCherry) at a 1:1 ratio.
Add 25 μL of SARS-CoV-2 pseudovirus from row D up to row A and from row H up to row E.
For column 11, add 25 μL of virus; this will be the virus only control.
For column 12, add 25 μL of infection media; this will be the cells only control.
Add the virus from the most diluted plasma to the least diluted plasma (row D to A; row H to E).
Cover the dilution plate and incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 1 h.
Wash the half area 96-well plate containing Vero E6 hACE T2A TMPRSS2 target cells with 50 μL of 1× PBS twice to remove residual growth media, but gently without disturbing the cells.

Transfer 50 μL of the pre-incubated plasma-virus mixture from rows A to D of the U- or V-bottom plates to its corresponding wells of the 96-well plate containing Vero E6 hACE T2A TMPRSS2 target cells with a multichannel pipette.
Change tips for each row to decrease risk of cross-contamination.
Transfer plasma/virus mixture from rows E to H for the duplicate sample.
Transfer the plasma-pseudovirus mixture from the least diluted to the most diluted plasma sample without changing tips.
Incubate (infection) at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Place the plate in the Celigo Image Cytometer approximately 16-24 hours post infection.
Start the Celigo cytometer system according to standard protocol.
Choose the correct plate type and create a unique Plate ID.
Select “Load Plate.”
In the “Scan” tab, under “Application,” select “Expression Analysis.”
Select “Target 1 + 2 + 3” for three channels needed for two-color fluorescence analysis.
Label the channels as BF, color 1 (e.g., eGFP), and color 2 (e.g., red fluorescent protein for mCherry).
Select BF as your first channel.
Under "Motion Control," select "Focus Setup" and "Register Auto."
Set a minor offset (-5 to -10) using the down arrow next to "Auto Focus."
For the first fluorescence analysis, select your second channel.
Label it as “GFP VOC 1” if it is a pseudovirus that encodes eGFP.
Choose the ‘Green 483/536’ under illumination and exposure time.
Select "Find Focus" after proper exposure.
Then select "Set Offset."
Select your third channel for fluorescence analysis.
Label the selected channel as "mCherry VOC 2".
Choose ‘Red 531/629’ under illumination and exposure time settings.
Select “Find Focus” after setting proper exposure time.
Select “Set Offset”.
Highlight all wells using your cursor to ensure they light up yellow.
Select “Start Scan” to begin the analysis.
Under the “Analysis Settings”, select “Well Mask” and set the “% Well Mask” to 100%.
Under “Identification”, ensure correct channel is selected and set the “Cell Diameter” to 15 μm.
Set the “Cell Area” to 40 μm² under “Pre-Filtering” settings.
Export the data by selecting “Export Well-Level Data”.
